newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mixed - gains or losses small.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mixed - gains or losses small.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Monday, but rises and losses were limited.
Gasoline edged higher tracking firmer NWE values, higher crude futures and recent arbitrage interest to the U.S. and Colombia for cat gasoline.
"Gasoline is undervalued in respect to naphtha," said one Italian trader, noting a weak margin.
He said interest from Eastern Mediterranean destinations and Italian downstream requirements for December underpinned prices.
The end to the French truckers' strike had little impact on the Med as exports were seen generally stable by Monday.
But demand boosted NWE values as a strike continued at Elf refineries. Naphtha rose slightly in quiet trading.

Gas oil retreated in line with IPE futures, which finished 50 cents lower on weak U.S. heating oil. But trade was quiet and premiums were notionally stable. Heating oil was seen at high cif +$1/1.50 basis Genoa.

The low sulphur diesel market is well supplied with fair Italian and French buying interest, with values around the $10/12 premium to heating oil seen in northern Europe. Two heating oil/low sulphur diesel combies remain on offer into France and Italy.

The Turkish and Portuguese buy tenders for up to $125,000 tonnes of heavy fuel oil announced last week gave support, but did not push wet prices still assessed around $109 fob Med with a healthy contango. Swap talk was heard around $112-113 fob.
Supplies were seen to be fairly good with a prompt Greek cargo of good quality bunker spec heard offered high fob +$1/2.

A Turkish tender to buy 25-30,000 tonnes of low sulphur cracked fuel was awarded to a major at an undisclosed price for delivery into Tutunciftlik by 15-17 December. Cargoes were put around the low $140s cif. ++ 44 171 542 8980
